content.constraint: .agent-factory/** canonical 파일의 생성·수정·검증은 primary repository에서 owning manager로만 수행하며, 이를 위해 Git worktree를 만들거나 linked worktree 안에서 직접 수정하지 않는다.
content.rationale: Human이 확인한 Agent Factory 규칙이며 Intake, Work Unit, Specification canonical artifact의 single-writer 및 primary-root 경계를 보존한다.

requirements: Expose one stable Human-facing review action keyed by Work Unit id, not filesystem path.
Present scope, changed-file summary, AI review findings, verification evidence, tests-not-run disclosure, limitations, and the two actions request rework or complete.
Translate Human action through work_unit.py and integration orchestration without showing scripts, branches, commits, raw JSON, or absolute paths by default.
Keep a disclosure path for troubleshooting details only when explicitly requested.
Make complete fail closed: integration failure must remain visible and must not be reported as completed.

criteria: Given a Work Unit in review, the Human can inspect a sanitized result without receiving an internal skill path or absolute worktree path.
A rework instruction is recorded exactly, starts a new revision on the same Work Unit, and returns to review after execution.
A complete choice either records completion and integrates to factory successfully, or surfaces a distinct integration failure without claiming success.
The review summary clearly distinguishes verification performed from verification not run.
Internal diagnostic evidence remains available to the Main Agent without becoming the default Human view.
